mapper.select:
SELECT MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber,
MEMBER_ID AS memberId,
MEMBER_PASSWORD AS memberPassword,
MEMBER_NAME AS memberName,
MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS memberPhoneNumber,
RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER AS residentRegistrationNumber,
PRIMARY_ADDRESS AS primaryAddress,
DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress,
POSTAL_CODE AS postalCode,
ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus,
MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus
FROM MEMBER
WHERE MEMBER_STATUS = '환자' AND RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER LIKE #{rrnPrefix} || '%'
ORDER BY MEMBER_NUMBER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_NUMBER, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER, RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, PRIMARY_ADDRESS, DETAILED_ADDRESS, POSTAL_CODE, ACCOUNT_STATUS, MEMBER_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{memberNumber}, #{memberId}, #{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhoneNumber}, #{residentRegistrationNumber}, #{primaryAddress}, #{detailedAddress}, #{postalCode}, #{accountStatus}, #{memberStatus} )
